title: Socialismus: Channelizer
description: The resource provider! Enables synchronization feature for other modules using BungeeCord channels.

<details>
<summary>Accessibility</summary>

**SOCIALISMUS CHANNELIZER — MODULARITY WAVE**

**Supported Platforms**  
`SPIGOTMC` · `FOLIA` · `VELOCITY` · `PAPERPMC`

**Supported Versions**  
`1.16.x` and newer

A lightweight network synchronization module that enables cross-server communication using plugin messaging channels, allowing synchronization features to work across an entire Minecraft network without requiring Redis or external infrastructure.

---

**Dependencies & Information**

**Socialismus required**  
This is not a standalone plugin. Channelizer is a module that extends the functionality of the Socialismus plugin and cannot be started independently.

**General**  
You can use this module with Socialismus running on Velocity or a Spigot-based server implementation.
